# Copilot Instructions

Before making changes, read `AGENTS.md` and the files under `docs/`.

Optimize for hackathon speed:

- implement complete slices instead of partial scaffolding,
- prefer simple, well-supported libraries,
- keep the app runnable after every change,
- update `docs/tasks.md` as part of the work.

Do not ask the user to manually code when the repository can be changed directly.
